about: Route gates (can a non-PR enrol in and finish a course that leads to the occupation) for trades, engineering, IT, accounting and VETASSESS management occupations. traPsaQualification.value: TRA Provisional Skills Assessment (first step to the Job Ready Program) accepts a qualification issued by a CRICOS-registered RTO, completed in Australia, matching the nominated occupation, without RPL (Guidelines v2.0, April 2026)
traPsaQualification.quote: Be issued by a CRICOS registered RTO. Be completed in Australia. Match the Nominated Occupation you selected for your PSA application.

traAqoCaution.value: TRA's Australian Qualifications by Occupation list (3 December 2025) tells international students to check training.gov.au and seek advice on any eligibility requirements or restrictions before studying
traAqoCaution.quote: International students intending study in Australia should consult training.gov.au and seek advice on suitability of any training for their preferred occupation, including any eligibility requirements or restrictions.
